paite: TOUPA tuh hon chingpa ahi a; ka tasam kei ding hi.
heading: David La / TOUPA, Chingpa Muanhuai
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

paite: Ama'n loupa hing nou mitmet mun ah hon kualsak zel a; tui dai dide kiang ah hon pi zel hi.
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

paite: Ka hinna ahon bawlhoihsak zel a, ama min ziak in diktatna lampi ah hon pi zel hi.
english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

paite: Ahi, sihna lim phaizang tawn mah leng, gilou himhim ka lau kei ding; nang ka kiang ah na om ngal a, na khetbuk leh na chiangkhun in hon khamuan zel hi.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

paite: Hon doute mitmuh in ka ma ah dohkan na bawlkhol a; ka lutang thau na nilh khin a, ka nou adimlet hi.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

paite: Pel lou in hoihna leh zahngaihna in ka damsung teng in hon zui zel ding ua; huchi in TOUPA' inn ah tangtawn in ka om nilouhta ding hi.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
